How To Start Using AI in Your Business

How can business owners and employees begin using AI without being overwhelmed by the technology? In this Paychex THRIVE podcast episode, AI and innovation speaker Dan Chuparkoff joins host Gene Marks to discuss AI adoption, experimentation, and practical ways businesses can begin using AI assistants. The conversation explores what “using AI” can mean in everyday work, how to think about connecting AI tools to business data, privacy and permissions considerations, opportunities for small businesses to build AI applications, and examples of AI-assisted knowledge retrieval and conversation capture. The episode also examines whether imperfect business data limits AI use and how AI can provide feedback as a coach. Learn more about getting started with AI for small businesses, or explore Paychex WISE to see how Paychex is applying AI across workforce operations.

  • 00:00 - Episode Preview and Guest Introduction
  • 01:31 - Dan's Work as a Speaker & Career Path
  • 04:54 - AI, Change, and Public Perception
  • 09:00 - What “Using AI” Actually Means

  • 30:36 - Wrap Up and Thank You
